status: source-audited development contract; v1 execution and independent thresholds pending
instruction: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.

native_success.block_order: ascending world x when run_reward registers the sequence

coverage_predicate.xy: covering-cup bounding polygon contains block bounding polygon

native_success.sequence_semantics: Checks advance at most one stage per reward step; earlier successful stages are consumed, not required to persist simultaneously.

native_limitations: Coverage uses outer projected bounds and vertical extrema; it does not certify a physically empty cup cavity.
Cup axis constraints are checked at registered stages, not continuously throughout every motion.
The score does not itself constitute an independent contact/penetration audit.

generation_contract.proposed_reference: Three cup transfers covering blocks in initial left-to-right order, then three uncovering transfers in red/green/blue order, then both arms return.
generation_contract.preserve: A single initial scene and persistent released cup poses across all six transfers.
generation_contract.hollow_geometry: Retain native cup collision geometry; a solid outer OBB or single convex hull cannot certify cup-block clearance.
generation_contract.do_not_require: Do not add block grasping, relocation, or cup-block contact as a task requirement.

implementation_status.v1: Full physical reference and cup-cavity contact validation are not implemented yet.
required_before_export: Native full sequence and movement constraints pass
Cavity-aware collision handling and independent penetration checks
